2.57 Employment. Employment in the eight county study area was 161,680 in 1972 and is projected to be 212,660 by 2020. The study area's unemployment rate was 9.1 percent compared to the State's 3.7 percent. The unemployment rate is projected to remain essentially the same for the study area through 2020 (tables II-1 and II-3). Distribution of the 1972 work force is shown by county in table II-3.
